statements.status_notes: The Harbor registry 2.13, 2.14, and 2.15 compiled dependency graphs include github.com/miekg/dns through the registry's ACME stack: rsc.io/letsencrypt imports github.com/xenolf/lego/acme, which imports miekg/dns. CVE-2019-19794 affects predictable DNS transaction IDs and is fixed in miekg/dns v1.1.25. Updating to that release does not compile with the legacy xenolf/lego dependency because lego references dns.ErrTruncated, an API removed from miekg/dns before the fixed release. Remediation requires an upstream migration of the legacy ACME dependency chain rather than a compatible version-only bump.
